mapper.sql: param_id, scope_type, scope_id, target_size_id, calibration_type, adjustment_value, is_manual, enabled, status, sample_size, unique_user_count, feedback_distribution, confidence_level, effective_from, effective_until, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time

cp.param_id, cp.scope_type, cp.scope_id, CASE WHEN cp.scope_type = 'SCHOOL' THEN COALESCE(ss.school_name, CONCAT('学校#', cp.scope_id)) WHEN cp.scope_type = 'PRODUCT' THEN COALESCE(su.name, CONCAT('商品#', cp.scope_id)) ELSE '全局' END AS scope_name, cp.target_size_id, COALESCE(sz.size_name, CONCAT('尺码#', cp.target_size_id), '全部尺码') AS target_size_name, cp.calibration_type, cp.adjustment_value, cp.is_manual, cp.enabled, cp.status, cp.sample_size, cp.unique_user_count, cp.feedback_distribution, cp.confidence_level, cp.effective_from, cp.effective_until, cp.version, CASE WHEN cp.version = ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(p2.version), 0) FROM calibration_params p2 WHERE p2.scope_type = cp.scope_type AND (p2.scope_id = cp.scope_id OR (p2.scope_id IS NULL AND cp.scope_id IS NULL)) AND (p2.target_size_id = cp.target_size_id OR (p2.target_size_id IS NULL AND cp.target_size_id IS NULL)) AND p2.calibration_type = cp.calibration_type ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS latest_version, CASE WHEN cp.enabled = TRUE AND cp.effective_from <= NOW() AND (cp.effective_until IS NULL OR cp.effective_until >= NOW()) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS effective_now, CASE WHEN cp.enabled = TRUE AND cp.effective_from <= NOW() AND (cp.effective_until IS NULL OR cp.effective_until >= NOW()) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM calibration_params newer WHERE newer.scope_type = cp.scope_type AND (newer.scope_id = cp.scope_id OR (newer.scope_id IS NULL AND cp.scope_id IS NULL)) AND (newer.target_size_id = cp.target_size_id OR (newer.target_size_id IS NULL AND cp.target_size_id IS NULL)) AND newer.calibration_type = cp.calibration_type AND newer.enabled = TRUE AND newer.effective_from <= NOW() AND (newer.effective_until IS NULL OR newer.effective_until >= NOW()) AND newer.version > cp.version ) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS shadowed_by_higher_version, cp.create_by, cp.create_time, cp.update_by, cp.update_time

LEFT JOIN s_schools ss ON cp.scope_type = 'SCHOOL' AND cp.scope_id = CAST(ss.school_id AS CHAR) LEFT JOIN s_uniform su ON cp.scope_type = 'PRODUCT' AND cp.scope_id = CAST(su.id AS CHAR) LEFT JOIN s_sizes sz ON cp.target_size_id = sz.id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM calibration_params cp
WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM calibration_params source WHERE source.param_id = #{paramId} AND source.scope_type = cp.scope_type AND (source.scope_id = cp.scope_id OR (source.scope_id IS NULL AND cp.scope_id IS NULL)) AND (source.target_size_id = cp.target_size_id OR (source.target_size_id IS NULL AND cp.target_size_id IS NULL)) AND source.calibration_type = cp.calibration_type ) ORDER BY cp.version DESC, cp.param_id DESC

SELECT ca.audit_id, ca.param_id, ca.action, ca.old_value, ca.new_value, ca.reason, ca.operator, ca.create_time FROM calibration_audit ca INNER JOIN calibration_params cp ON cp.param_id = ca.param_id WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM calibration_params source WHERE source.param_id = #{paramId} AND source.scope_type = cp.scope_type AND (source.scope_id = cp.scope_id OR (source.scope_id IS NULL AND cp.scope_id IS NULL)) AND (source.target_size_id = cp.target_size_id OR (source.target_size_id IS NULL AND cp.target_size_id IS NULL)) AND source.calibration_type = cp.calibration_type ) ORDER BY ca.create_time DESC, ca.audit_id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calibration_params ( scope_type, scope_id, target_size_id, calibration_type, adjustment_value, is_manual, enabled, status, sample_size, unique_user_count, feedback_distribution, confidence_level, effective_from, effective_until, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) VALUES ( #{scopeType}, #{scopeId}, #{targetSizeId}, #{calibrationType}, #{adjustmentValue}, #{isManual}, #{enabled}, #{status}, #{sampleSize}, #{uniqueUserCount}, #{feedbackDistribution}, #{confidenceLevel}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveUntil}, #{version}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE calibration_params SET scope_type = #{scopeType}, scope_id = #{scopeId}, target_size_id = #{targetSizeId}, calibration_type = #{calibrationType}, adjustment_value = #{adjustmentValue}, is_manual = #{isManual}, enabled = #{enabled}, status = #{status}, sample_size = #{sampleSize}, unique_user_count = #{uniqueUserCount}, feedback_distribution = #{feedbackDistribution}, confidence_level = #{confidenceLevel}, effective_from = #{effectiveFrom}, effective_until = #{effectiveUntil}, version = #{version}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE param_id = #{paramId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO calibration_audit ( param_id, action, old_value, new_value, reason, operator, create_time ) VALUES ( #{paramId}, #{action}, #{oldValue}, #{newValue}, #{reason}, #{operator}, #{createTime} )
